The '''EU LCS 2017 Summer''' Split was the tenth split of the [[European League of Legends Championship Series]], organized by Riot Games. The season ran from June 1 to September 3, 2017, with matches played in Berlin, Germany, and the Finals hosted in Paris, France. Ten teams competed in a Group Stage consisting of two groups of five, followed by a Single Elimination Best-of-Five Playoff. The top three teams of each group advanced to the Playoffs, while the bottom team was sent to the [[LCS/Europe/2018/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]]. The split featured a total prize pool of $200,000 USD, and the winner earned a spot at the [[World_Championship/2017|2017 World Championship]].

Ahead of the split, the EU LCS saw significant roster and organizational changes. [[Fnatic Academy]] and [[Misfits Academy]] sold their newly earned LCS spots to [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]] and [[Mysterious Monkeys]] respectively, while [[Origen]] and [[Giants Gaming]] were relegated.

{{ShowBracket|id=BU5L3EBPYX}}
==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
**Two groups of five teams each
**Each team plays 13 matches.
***Double Round Robin within own group
***Single Round Robin against other group
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
**Top 3 from each group qualifies to the [[LCS/Europe/Spring/2017/Playoffs|Spring Playoffs]]
**Group winners receive playoff byes into the semifinals
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
* Winner Qualifies for [[World_Championship/2017|2017 World Championship]]
